cases.explain: «Многие народы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law shall go out of Zion, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem.

cases.explain: «таршишские корабли» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: for all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.
